description.value: Thelma & Marcella's Sips Cafe is a single-storey retail cafe located on 100 Avenue in Fort St. John, a hub city for cyclists travelling the Alaska Highway corridor in northeastern BC. The cafe's distinctive name suggests an independent, owner-operated establishment rather than a chain. It was verified as open by an OSM contributor as recently as March 2026.
